Semantic check of the exact scaffold: `preimagesNat 0 = []` is correct because the original reverse-add step of a positive integer is positive; for `Y>0`, the algorithm invokes the existing complete predecessor list with `Agent109.digits Y` and `Agent101.digitFn`. The intended layer recurrence is semantically correct: a member at depth k is exactly a positive n with original `Lychrel196.orbit n k = Y`; disjoint predecessor fibers follow from the fact that each n has one deterministic `step n`. The base zero-depth specification, base Nodup, and zero-target empty result are the only proved declarations in the WIP source. No claim is made for the missing general theorems.

The concrete missing proof bridge is `Agent109.canon_digits Y` → `Agent101.canonicalDigits (Agent109.digits Y)` → `Agent101.canonicalDigits_iff` to obtain `Canonical Y targetDigitFn (targetWord.length)`. Then prove `PreimagesSpec` by rewriting target zero separately and applying `Agent105Predecessors9df76b.mem_predecessors` in the positive case. The layer iff is induction on k using `List.mem_flatMap`, `PreimagesSpec`, and `Lychrel196.orbit_from_step`; Nodup at the successor uses prior-layer Nodup plus disjointness of fibers for unequal target values; empty persistence reduces by induction to `List.flatMap_nil`.

Exact compiler handoff: checkout branch `research/agent-105/backward-layers-9df76b-20261016` at source commit `59091760af8afa25c65561a35701e3963cd1f934`, use Lean 4.19.0 (`6caaee842e94`) and a fresh build directory. First compile its complete registered dependency closure (including the unchanged `TemplateStep` module and the 15-module PR169 closure) to fresh `.olean`s; then compile the new file with that fresh directory first in `LEAN_PATH`, e.g. `LEAN_PATH=<fresh-olean-dir>:proofs lean --trust=0 -o <fresh-olean-dir>/Agent105BackwardLayers9df76b.olean proofs/Agent105BackwardLayers9df76b.lean`. Save exact argv, stdout/stderr, exit code, toolchain and source hashes. If this passes, run `#print axioms` for every new exported theorem and rebuild the entire frozen dependency closure in a second empty directory with `--trust=0`. Do not use stale `.olean`s or native_decide. Please return actual compiler diagnostics only; a source read is not a build.

I am not repeating absent-tool probes. Until a real Lean runner responds, `59091760` remains WIP. I retain source ownership and will apply any concrete diagnostics to a new immutable checkpoint.
